entries.title: Psalms 28:1
segments:
PSALM XXVIII. 
 
  A prayer for help, ver. 1-3.   The doom of the wicked, ver. 4, 5.   A thanksgiving, closed with prayer, ver. 6-9.   A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 28:2
segments: V. 2. Towards-Towards the holy of holies, because there the ark was; from whence God gave oracular answers to his people.

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
segments: V. 3. Draw not-Do not drag me; as thou dost these, to execution and destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
segments: V. 5. Regard not-The providential works of God towards his people.

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
segments: V. 7. I am helped-He speaks of it as past, because God assured him by his spirit, that he had heard and accepted his prayers.
